name: Honda Gold Wing GL1800
engine: 1,832 cc liquid-cooled flat six, fuel injected, shaft drive
intro: Honda's big touring flat six. Long-lived, with several recalls to clear and linked brakes to service right.

A-002.title: Check for open recalls
A-002.instructions: Run your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls. Recall 11V567 covered rear brake drag on many 2001-2010 and 2012-2015 GL1800s. Airbag-equipped bikes from 2006-2016 had inflator recalls (16V347, 17V031, 18V045). Book any open recall with a Honda dealer.
A-002.reason: Brake drag can overheat the rear brake, and airbag inflators can fail dangerously. Both repairs are free.

K: The front and rear brakes are linked through a secondary master cylinder. Follow the manual's bleed order.

recalls.what: Rear brake may drag after release.
recalls.fix: Free dealer repair of the secondary master cylinder.
Dealer replaces the airbag module free.
